jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(2)(D) inventory: South Burlington Supervisory District -- the South Burlington School District, a city school district that is its own supervisory district (member: City of South Burlington), governed by its city charter (24 App. V.S.A. ch. 13). Operates PK-12.

board.post_note: South Burlington: seven directors elected at large under the city charter (expanded from five by the March 5, 2024 charter vote), on a mix of three-year and two-year seats under the charter transition schedule.

sources.note: City of South Burlington official results, March 3, 2026: Emilee Hoffman elected to a 3-year term (2,768 votes, end 2029); Daniel Boyer to a 2-year term (2,594, end 2028); Michelle Boyer to "2 Years Remaining on a 3 Year Term" (2,676, end 2028) -- her remainder-term seat documents a mid-term vacancy in the March-2025 cohort (the departed holder and any interim appointment are unidentified in fetched sources). The other four directors (Abshere, Chair; Lawrence, Vice Chair/Clerk; Chittenden; Galvez) are established by the board's Oct. 7, 2026 minutes (full board acting; the two extra "present" names are non-voting student representatives) -- their term ends rest on the city clerk's certified March 4, 2025 return, which was not fetched, so NO ends are minted for them. Charter: the board was expanded from five to seven by the voters on March 5, 2024 (3,815-977; H.886), all elected at large. FLAGS: Chelsea Tillinghast (elected 2024, term to 2027) is off the board with no resignation/appointment document fetched -- no record is minted for her; Hoffman and Boyer appear in July 2025 minutes before their March 2026 elections, consistent with undocumented vacancy appointments -- their current seats rest on the certified 2026 returns.
